is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated the efficacy of indoor residual spraying and insecticide-treated nets against wild populations of Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2, 'Methods: Study sites and experimental huts').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study does not genotype any resistance markers; it only references previous publications regarding the presence of kdr in the local Ladji mosquito population (page 2: 'The local An. gambiae population is comprised entirely of the M taxon and is resistant to pyrethroids and DDT, with kdr at high frequency and metabolic resistance also present [9,17]').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotyping was performed in this study; hence no genotype counts, sample sizes for genotyping, or allele frequencies are reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were free-flying wild field populations entering experimental huts in Ladji, a peri-urban area on the periphery of Cotonou, Benin (page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research paper reporting experimental hut trials conducted between April and June 2005 (page 2).

sub_country_location.evidence: The field site is reported as Ladji, Cotonou, southern Benin (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Field hut evaluations were conducted from '8 April to 24 June 2005' (page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine field experimental hut trial with no indication of shared specimen data.

supplement.evidence: No external supplementary files are mentioned as holding missing genotype data.

assessment.summary: This study is an experimental hut trial in Ladji, Benin evaluating the efficacy and residual activity of microencapsulated chlorpyrifos-methyl (IRS and ITN) compared to DDT and lambdacyhalothrin against wild pyrethroid-resistant An. gambiae and Cx. quinquefasciatus. Although the presence of kdr in the study population is cited from earlier publications, no molecular marker genotyping was performed in this study.
exclusion_reasons: No target resistance markers were genotyped; the study relies on previous citations for the presence of kdr in the local vector population.
Lacks extractable genotype or allele counts/frequencies.
